notes.title: Update Notes for 6.21
notes.notes:
1.Reduced the power consumption rate of the flashlight.

2.Added 10 specific light sources to nearly every scene, making the visuals slightly brighter.

3.Added hints to certain levels and reduced their difficulty.

4.Adjusted Lumen global illumination settings to make the scene lighting more realistic.
